answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock $100 for 30 days before bidding for work, whether sourcing saffron, transcribing a whisper, or tracking a comet. Voting weight and job quotas scale with locked funds, so splitting one deposit among fake identities creates no extra influence or capacity. An attacker running 10,000 identities must immobilize $1 million, paying borrowing costs or forgoing returns throughout the lockup.
